name: web_search
description: General web search using DDGS (Dux Distributed Global Search) supporting multiple search engines including Google, Bing, Brave, Yahoo, and DuckDuckGo. No API keys required. Parallel Search MCP, SerpBase, Firecrawl Search, Outcrawl Search, and the SpecStream Search API are opt-in; selecting any of them sends the query to that hosted third-party service, so do not submit sensitive or patient-identifying information. SerpBase additionally requires SERPBASE_API_KEY and returns real Google SERP results (billed per request), useful when DDGS's Google backend is unavailable or rate-limited.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return

backend.description: Search engine backend to use. Selecting 'parallel' sends the query to https://search.parallel.ai/mcp; that backend does not apply ToolUniverse region or safesearch controls. Selecting 'serpbase' sends the query to https://api.serpbase.dev (requires SERPBASE_API_KEY) for real Google SERP results; that backend applies region but not safesearch. Selecting 'firecrawl' sends the query to https://api.firecrawl.dev/v2/search (FIRECRAWL_API_KEY optional); that backend applies region as a country code only and safesearch as a two-state filter ('on' and 'moderate' filter, 'off' does not). Selecting 'outcrawl' sends the query to https://api.outcrawl.ai/v1/search (requires OUTCRAWL_API_KEY); that backend does not apply ToolUniverse region or safesearch controls and returns at most 20 results. Selecting 'keenable' sends the query to https://api.keenable.ai (KEENABLE_API_KEY optional); that backend does not apply ToolUniverse region or safesearch controls. Selecting 'specstream' sends the query to https://api.specstream.ai/v1/web-search (requires SPECSTREAM_API_KEY); that backend applies region as a country code only and maps safesearch 'on', 'moderate' and 'off' to its strict, moderate and off levels.

region.description: Search region/locale for DDGS backends, and country/language for the SerpBase backend (split on the hyphen into gl/hl). Firecrawl and SpecStream use the country half only as an ISO code ('uk' maps to 'GB', 'ja' to 'JP'); the language half is not applied. Parallel and Outcrawl do not support this control; only the default value is accepted with backend='parallel' or backend='outcrawl'.

safesearch.description: Safe search level for DDGS backends. Parallel, SerpBase, and Outcrawl do not support this control; only the default value is accepted with those backends. Firecrawl has a two-state filter: 'on' and 'moderate' both enable it, 'off' leaves it unset. SpecStream maps 'on' to strict, 'moderate' to moderate and 'off' to off.

SERPBASE_API_KEY.purpose: Query the backend='serpbase' option for real Google SERP results (https://api.serpbase.dev), billed per request.
SERPBASE_API_KEY.without: web_search still works via DDGS/Parallel/DuckDuckGo-HTML/Wikipedia; backend='serpbase' is blocked without it.

FIRECRAWL_API_KEY.purpose: Authenticate the backend='firecrawl' option (Firecrawl Search, https://api.firecrawl.dev/v2/search). Searches are billed against the account's credits (a free key includes 1,000) and use the account's rate limits instead of the keyless cap.
FIRECRAWL_API_KEY.without: backend='firecrawl' still works keyless within Firecrawl's per-IP daily request and credit cap (HTTP 429 past it, then the normal DDGS fallback). The cap is per IP, so users behind one shared server or NAT share it. The default web_search chain is unaffected.

OUTCRAWL_API_KEY.purpose: Authenticate the backend='outcrawl' option (Outcrawl Search, https://api.outcrawl.ai/v1/search). Searches are billed against the account's credits (the free tier includes 1,000 credits a month).
OUTCRAWL_API_KEY.without: web_search still works via DDGS/Parallel/DuckDuckGo-HTML/Wikipedia; backend='outcrawl' falls back to the normal DDGS chain without it.

KEENABLE_API_KEY.purpose: Authenticate the backend='keenable' option against Keenable's keyed Search API (https://api.keenable.ai/v1/search) for the account's rate limits.
KEENABLE_API_KEY.without: backend='keenable' still works keyless via Keenable's public endpoint (https://api.keenable.ai/v1/search/public), which is rate-limited. The default web_search chain is unaffected.

SPECSTREAM_API_KEY.purpose: Authenticate the backend='specstream' option (SpecStream Search API, https://api.specstream.ai/v1/web-search). Searches are billed against the account's balance.
SPECSTREAM_API_KEY.without: web_search still works via DDGS/Parallel/DuckDuckGo-HTML/Wikipedia; backend='specstream' falls back to the normal DDGS chain without it.
